title: Analytic: graphene sheet transmission and absorption, far infrared (FDFD)
description:
A normally incident plane wave (mode_source toward +x in a y-periodic vacuum strip, 0.2 um cells, CPML along x) crosses a doped graphene monolayer (conducting_sheet, graphene_kubo: E_F = 0.4 eV, tau = 0.1 ps, 300 K) on a vertical line; frequency_domain study 10-100 um. A flux line between source and sheet gives the net power P_in (1 - R), one behind it P_in T.
Analytic (zero-thickness sheet in vacuum, t = 1 / (1 + eta0 sigma_s / 2)): T = 1 / ((1 + eta0 sigma_r / 2)^2 + (eta0 sigma_i / 2)^2), A = eta0 sigma_r T, R = 1 - T - A, with the Kubo conductivity in its T -> 0 form (exp(+j omega t)): intraband Drude sigma = D tau / (1 + j omega tau), D tau = e^2 E_F tau / (pi hbar^2) = 4.71e-3 S, plus the interband term -(j sigma_0 / pi) ln|(hbar omega - 2 E_F) / (hbar omega + 2 E_F)| (capacitive, sigma_0 = e^2 / (4 hbar); 1-2 % of Im sigma here, below the 2 E_F = 0.8 eV absorption edge at 1.55 um, so no interband loss). Thermal corrections at 300 K are < 1e-6 relative (E_F = 15.5 kT). Drude regime: T falls from 0.993 at 10 um to 0.640 at 100 um (omega tau = 1.88), A rises to 0.250.
Curves & tables tab: T, R and A (plot TRA) with the dotted references.
Spectra tab: 'transmitted' power vs the dashed P_in T(lambda).
Derived values tab: T and A at 40 and 100 um with their references.
Expected agreement: ~1e-4 absolute (CPML reflection floor and the grid correction k0 w / sin(k w) - 1 ~ 5e-4 of eta0 sigma_s / 2 at 20 um); to be confirmed by a first run.
